name: Tumbling Wrack
description: Tumble the whole body into the foe in a blow that wrecks stance and guard together.

name: Warp Lock
description: Warp the qi of a foe's limbs into a lock that binds them to their own twisted stance.

name: Discordant Veil
description: Draw a veil of discordant qi over the body that sours every technique cast toward it.

name: Havoc Mark
description: Mark a foe with a spot of chaos that grows in disorder with each move they make.

name: Ruin Spiral
description: Spiral ruinous chaos qi outward in widening rings that tear the order from all within them.

name: Fractal Rend
description: Drive a splitting wedge of disorder that breaks again into smaller wedges deep inside the target.

name: Unravel Wave
description: Send a long wave that unravels each technique and formation it passes across the field.

name: Chaos Lance
description: Hurl a lance of wild force that bends round every ward and finds the nearest weak seam.

name: Disorder Tempest
description: Raise a tempest of pure disorder over the field that tears at friend and foe by no rule.

name: Reality Fray
description: Fray the ordering of matter and qi in a wide field so that solid things shed their form.

name: Pattern Sovereign
description: Rule over the patterns of the field and forbid any foe to hold a fixed form of technique.

name: Chaos Edict
description: Declare chaos over the field in a decree whose reach and weight scale with the user's reserve.

name: Disorder Cataclysm
description: Loose all stored chaos qi in a cataclysm that breaks the order of a whole battlefield to the ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Entropic Lash
description: Lash out with a whip of entropy that ages and weakens whatever it strikes.

name: Misrule Grasp
description: Take hold of a foe with a grasp of misrule that turns their commands against their own limbs.

name: Wrack Pulse
description: Pulse a wracking shock from the core through the ground to rattle all who stand near.

name: Anarchic Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of anarchic force that the foe cannot predict or push through.

name: Doomed Pattern
description: Mark every standing pattern in range as doomed and let them fall one by one.

name: Ruin Torrent
description: Pour a torrent of ruin outward from the core and drown the field in churning force.

name: Chaos Spear
description: Cast a spear of formless force that finds its own path to the heart of the target.

name: Mayhem Wrath
description: Rain wrathful blows that each break a different part of the foe's art and stance.

name: Sovereign Discord
description: Hold a sovereign discord over the field in which no foe's technique may stand whole.

name: Law Shatter
description: Shatter the laws that bind foes' formations and techniques into one tumbled ruin.

name: Unraveling Dominion
description: Unravel the ordering of a single body from within in one stroke that no ward can bar.

name: Edict of Ruin
description: Pronounce an edict of ruin whose reach and weight scale with the user's core and reserve.

name: Anarchy Crowned
description: Crown the user in anarchy that wards the body and breaks the field to a measure set by the core.

name: Firmament Unmade
description: Unmake the order of the sky and ground over a vast front to the ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Entropy Unleashed
description: Unleash the full entropy of the core so that all matter and technique in the field decays toward ruin at the tier's ceiling.
